";let active=true;root.querySelector('[data-test]').onclick=async()=>{const b=root.querySelector('[data-test]');b.disabled=true;const times=[];try{for(let i=0;i<10&&active;i++){const start=performance.now();await xlink.status();times.push(performance.now()-start);root.querySelector('[data-out]').textContent=`${i+1}/10 samples collected`}if(times.length){const avg=times.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/times.length;root.querySelector('[data-out]').textContent=`Min ${Math.min(...times).toFixed(1)}ms · Avg ${avg.toFixed(1)}ms · Max ${Math.max(...times).toFixed(1)}ms`}}catch(e){root.querySelector('[data-out]').textContent='Test stopped: '+e.message}finally{b.disabled=false}};return()=>{active=false;root.replaceChildren()};
